name: The Wicked Dreadroot
pre_cutoff_record: JUMP-EN018 (January 2008 issue; official record has no exact date)
basis: Official English TCG card record dates its SHONEN JUMP magazine issue to January 2008; period KDE policy (https://www.etcg.de/uploads/pdf/KDE_YuGiOh_Policy.pdf) says magazine promos become legal on newsstand date in the release territory.
